headline.title: How GPT-5 helped immunologist Derya Unutmaz solve a 3-year-old mystery
headline.summary: Immunologist Derya Unutmaz utilized GPT-5 Pro to gain insights into T cell behavior, leading to the resolution of a three-year-old research mystery. This advancement has potential implications for cancer and autoimmune disease research.

articles.title: Oracle’s 21,000 layoffs help drive its debt-fueled AI investments
articles.summary: Oracle has announced 21,000 layoffs as part of a strategy to fund its significant investments in data center infrastructure for AI development. The company is leveraging these cost-cutting measures to support its ambitious growth in the artificial intelligence sector.

articles.title: T2D-Bench: Evidence-Gated Evaluation of LLM Outputs for Type 2 Diabetes Using a Multi-Layer Clinical-Lifestyle Knowledge Graph
articles.summary: T2D-Bench is a new benchmark and evaluation framework designed to assess the outputs of large language models (LLMs) in the context of type 2 diabetes management, focusing on adherence to clinical guidelines and justification of lifestyle-related claims. The framework utilizes a multi-layer clinical-lifestyle knowledge graph to ensure that LLM recommendations are supported by verifiable evidence.

articles.title: FlowR2A: Learning Reward-to-Action Distribution for Multimodal Driving Planning
articles.summary: FlowR2A introduces a novel approach to multimodal driving planning by learning a reward-to-action distribution that balances the benefits of scoring-based and anchor-based methods. This framework aims to enhance the efficiency of driving simulations by utilizing dense reward supervision while allowing for dynamic action proposals.

articles.title: MVG-KAN: Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN for PM$_{2.5}$ Forecasting
articles.summary: The article introduces MVG-KAN, a novel model for short-term PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting that leverages multi-view data to account for various influencing factors, including human activities and meteorological conditions. This approach aims to enhance the accuracy of air quality predictions, which are crucial for public health and urban management.

articles.title: Age of LLM: A Strategic 1v1 Benchmark for Reasoning, Diplomacy and Reliability of Large Language Models under Fog of War
articles.summary: The "Age of LLM" is a new turn-based benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) in a strategic 1v1 setting on a 13x7 grid, incorporating elements such as fog of war, diplomacy, and strict adherence to a JSON schema for actions. The private engine generates unique maps and opponents for each match, aiming to assess reasoning, diplomatic capabilities, and reliability under competitive conditions.

articles.title: FP8 is All You Need (Part 2): Efficient Ozaki-Bailey Style FFT Through Tensor-core Garner Reformulation and Kulisch Escape Route
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra (B300) GPU achieves approximately 1.3 TFLOPS in FP64 vector throughput, significantly lower than its predecessor, the B200. The Ozaki Scheme II framework enhances FP64-equivalent performance by utilizing FP8 tensor cores for dense matrix multiplication through a novel reconstruction method.

articles.title: Heterogeneous 2D/1D Signal Representation Fusion for Underwater Acoustic Modulation Recognition Under Distribution Shift
articles.summary: The article discusses a novel approach to underwater acoustic modulation recognition that integrates heterogeneous 2D and 1D signal representations to improve robustness under distribution shifts. It highlights the challenges posed by uneven degradation of these modalities and emphasizes the need for effective fusion techniques in practical applications.

articles.title: Integrated Sensing and Communications for Real-time Avatar Control in XR over 5G
articles.summary: The article discusses the integration of sensing and communication technologies to enhance real-time avatar control in Extended Reality (XR) environments over 5G networks. It highlights the need for high data rates and low-latency communication to improve gesture recognition and pose estimation, addressing limitations of current XR interaction methods.

articles.title: Deciphering Fingerprints of 3D Molecular Surfaces for Accurate Epitope Prediction
articles.summary: A new study introduces SurfBind, a surface-centric learning framework designed for more accurate epitope prediction by analyzing molecular surface representations. This approach addresses the limitations of existing methods that primarily focus on sequences or backbone structures, which often fail to identify discontinuous, surface-driven epitopes.

articles.title: E-MRL: Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Reliable 3D Tumor Analysis
articles.summary: The article presents E-MRL, a novel approach that utilizes Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning to enhance the reliability of 3D tumor analysis in medical imaging. This method aims to mitigate issues of visual hallucinations in Vision-Language Models by integrating visual perception with text fidelity in the diagnosis process.

articles.title: Deep Learning Approaches for 3D Medical Scene Completion: From Geometric Modeling to Generative Paradigms
articles.summary: This article provides a systematic review of advancements in three-dimensional scene completion in computer vision and robotics over the past decade, highlighting key developments from voxel semantic completion methods to contemporary generative approaches. The study emphasizes the significance of these advancements for applications such as autonomous navigation and augmented reality.
